parts.text: Please submit 3 days of PTO for me from 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-25 for family travel.

eval_cases.context: Turn 1: Agent must call `propose_leave_request(start_date='2026-11-23', end_date='2026-11-25', days=3.0, leave_type='PTO')` which creates `proposal_id='prop-8841'` (`status='PENDING'`, TTL=15m) and renders `<HITLConfirmationCard />`. Agent must NOT call `commit_leave_request` until user confirms.
eval_cases.reference: I have prepared a draft PTO request (`proposal_id: prop-8841`) for **3.0 days (2026-11-23 to 2026-11-25)**. Please review and click **Confirm** on the confirmation card within 15 minutes to submit this request to WorkWeek.

hitl_gate: Calls `propose_leave_request` and never calls `commit_leave_request` without confirmation.
Presents the proposal ID, dates (2026-11-23 to 2026-11-25), and remaining balance clearly.

parts.text: I confirmed proposal prop-9920 to update my remote work location in WorkWeek and open a laptop shipping ticket in ServiceImmediately, what happened?

eval_cases.context: Saga Execution Trace: Step 1 (`WorkWeek` relocation update `WW-TX-501`) succeeded (`HR_COMMITTED`). Step 2 (`ServiceImmediately` hardware provisioning ticket) failed with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable after retry budget. Saga Coordinator automatically invoked `revert_hr_record('WW-TX-501')` (`ROLLBACK_EXECUTED`) and queued async retry task `TASK-RETRY-77`.
eval_cases.reference: While updating your remote work location in WorkWeek (`WW-TX-501`) initially succeeded, ServiceImmediately returned a temporary service outage (`HTTP 503`) when creating your hardware ticket. To prevent inconsistent records, the system automatically executed a compensating rollback (`ROLLBACK_EXECUTED`) on `WW-TX-501` and queued your request (`TASK-RETRY-77`) for safe automatic retry.

saga_compensation: Explains that Step 1 (WorkWeek) was cleanly rolled back (`ROLLBACK_EXECUTED`) after Step 2 (ServiceImmediately) failed.
Provides the retry queue reference (`TASK-RETRY-77`) so the employee knows their request is safely tracked.

parts.text: My medical bereavement leave was denied twice and my paycheck is missing hours—nobody is helping me and I need to speak to a human HR specialist right now!

eval_cases.context: Sentiment Score: `-0.78` (below `-0.40` threshold). `EscalationAgent` invoked `create_warm_handoff_case(priority='P2', category='BEREAVEMENT_PAYROLL_ESCALATION')` -> `case_id='SI-HR-40912'` with DLP-redacted 5-turn conversation summary.
eval_cases.reference: I am so sorry you are dealing with this during such a difficult time. I have immediately escalated your case to a live People Operations Specialist (`Priority P2`, Case ID: **SI-HR-40912**) with a summary of your conversation so you won't have to repeat yourself. An HR Partner will reach out to you directly.

warm_handoff: Expresses genuine empathy for the bereavement and payroll distress.
Provides the live ServiceImmediately HR Case ID (`SI-HR-40912`) and confirms context has been attached.
